description: Install one or more components and their transitive registry dependencies into the Expo project. MIT Base needs no account. Returns the complete plan before writing; preserves a customized base-theme unless overwrite is true. Files go to src/components/<id>/ (or components/<id>/, or componentsPath from nativeanimation.json). Never overwrites differing files unless overwrite is true. Missing packages are reported as an `npx expo install ...` command; set install_dependencies to run it. Returns the import line to use. Copies the component source. Adapting its documented props to the app’s design tokens and content is a separate integration step; the tool does not automatically rebrand the component.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing.

expo_sdk.description: Expo SDK release to install. Defaults to installed Expo, then package.json, then the catalog current SDK. Incompatible installed dependencies and SDK overrides abort before writing; ask the user to resolve them in the CLI.

install_dependencies.description: Run `npx expo install` for missing packages.

path.description: Destination directory, relative to the project root.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the Expo project. Defaults to the directory the MCP server was started in.
